mapper.insert: insert into ai_content_preview_item(task_id, sequence_no, need_id, object_key, file_size, width, height) values(#{taskId}, #{sequenceNo}, #{needId}, #{objectKey}, #{fileSize}, #{width}, #{height})
mapper.select: select id, task_id, sequence_no, need_id, object_key, file_size, width, height from ai_content_preview_item where task_id=#{taskId} order by sequence_no
